title: Caddy Proxy configuration
description: Domains served by bfren/caddy-proxy - stored in /ssl/conf.json.

upstream.description: Upstream URL(s) - http or https, with optional port but no path. Multiple upstreams are load balanced.

lb.description: Load balancing selection policy, used when there are multiple upstreams.

route.description: An additional route - routes are evaluated in order, before the default upstream. Each must have exactly one of upstream, redirect or root.

path.description: Path matcher(s), e.g. /api/* - if omitted the route matches all requests.

stripPrefix.description: Prefix to remove from the path before proxying, e.g. /api.

redirect.description: Redirect to this URL - Caddy placeholders such as {http.request.uri.path} can be used.

root.description: Serve static files from this directory.

aliases.description: Additional host names - wildcards (e.g. *.example.com) require the dns challenge.

retry.description: How long to keep retrying an upstream that cannot be reached before showing the maintenance page, e.g. 10s (0s to disable) - defaults to BF_PROXY_UPSTREAM_RETRY.

challenge.description: ACME challenge used to obtain certificates - defaults to BF_PROXY_ACME_CHALLENGE.

redirectToPrimary.description: Redirect aliases to the primary domain - defaults to BF_PROXY_SSL_REDIRECT_TO_CANONICAL.

auth.description: Enable HTTP basic authentication: true for all users (see proxy-adduser), or a list of user names.

headers.description: Response headers to add or override (the secure headers are always added unless overridden).

compress.description: Compress responses using zstd or gzip (responses the upstream has already compressed are not compressed again).

clacks.description: Add the X-Clacks-Overhead: GNU Terry Pratchett response header.

custom.description: If true, /sites/<primary>.json is generated only if it does not exist - otherwise it is left alone, giving full control of the domain's configuration.
